objective: Test whether a coverage-constrained decision-adaptive acquisition policy can improve on cost-matched uniform measurement without recreating CG-6's self-reinforcing coverage collapse, while preserving most fixed-six decision quality. Calibration uses only already-unblinded CG-5 and CG-7 cohorts; evaluator capability is diagnostics-only.
interpretation_boundary: CG-8 calibration is exploratory. It reuses already-unblinded CG-5 and CG-7 societies and cannot support a confirmatory claim. A fresh CG-8 cohort may be generated only if one preregistered constrained-adaptive budget satisfies every frozen calibration selection requirement.

context.retrieval: Frozen CG-5 revised coverage graph with event reconciliation, Wilson conservative scores, and complete three-claim bundles.
context.flat_baseline: Frozen CG-5 bundle-aware flat retrieval over the exact same acquired evidence and matched context budget.

acquisition.coverage_constraint: Let s(c) be supplemental events acquired for each of the 48 current-agent/skill cells. A cell may receive its next supplemental event only when s(c) equals the current minimum supplemental count across all 48 cells. Therefore max_c s(c) - min_c s(c) is always at most one. Every full 48-event tier is completed before any cell can enter the next tier.
acquisition.coverage_constrained_decision: Within the currently least-measured supplemental tier only, rank cells using the frozen CG-6 decision-adaptive priority computed from reconciled observed evidence: Wilson interval width, minimum-support deficit, current selected mission roles, and plausible challengers. Evaluator capability and oracle pairs are forbidden inputs.
acquisition.uniform_round_robin: Frozen CG-7 comparator: repeatedly select the cell with the smallest reconciled total event count, with deterministic hashing for ties.
acquisition.fixed_six_replay: Acquire every remaining event required to reach six reconciled events in every current-agent/skill cell.

evaluation.primary_metric: mean expected mission success under revised coverage retrieval
evaluation.cost_metric: mean supplemental probe events per Field

selection_rule.choice: Choose the first constrained-adaptive budget in complexity_order satisfying every pooled and per-cohort requirement. If none qualifies, calibration selects no architecture and no fresh CG-8 confirmatory cohort may be generated.
